LanguageData.ZEN_DenseGrass.label: dense grass
LanguageData.ZEN_DenseGrass.description: Densely-grown grass, for those who like having a lawn. Dense grass takes more effort to plant and requires decent soil.
LanguageData.ZEN_PlantTreeCherry.label: zen cherry tree
LanguageData.ZEN_PlantTreeCherry.description: A vibrant and colorful tree often grown for decoration. Produces zen cherries in the spring and summer. Can also be chopped down for cherrywood.
LanguageData.ZEN_PlantTreeCrabapple.label: crabapple tree
LanguageData.ZEN_PlantTreeCrabapple.description: A colorful hardwood tree which grows small apples. Produces crabapples in the summer and fall. Can also be chopped down for wood.
LanguageData.ZEN_PlantTreePersimmon.label: persimmon tree
LanguageData.ZEN_PlantTreePersimmon.description: A hardwood tree well known for its delicious soft fruit and uniquely dark heartwood. Produces persimmons in the fall and winter. Can also be chopped down for ebony wood.
LanguageData.ZEN_TallHedge.label: tall hedge
LanguageData.ZEN_TallHedge.description: A tall shrubbery for lining paths or walkways. Does not prevent movement.
